scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace @wip/web && node scripts/python.mjs -m ruff check apps workers tests
scripts.format: prettier --check . && node scripts/python.mjs -m ruff format --check apps workers tests
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @wip/web && node scripts/python.mjs -m mypy apps/api workers
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @wip/web && node scripts/python.mjs -m pytest
scripts.migrate: node scripts/check-docker.mjs && docker compose run --rm api alembic upgrade head
scripts.migrate:local: node scripts/python.mjs --cwd apps/api -m alembic upgrade head
scripts.reset-db: node scripts/check-docker.mjs && docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d postgres redis minio && docker compose run --rm api alembic upgrade head
